```{r}

library(terra)
r <- rast("C:/Users/katy/Documents/KATY_TESIS_CL/insumos/Forest_height_2019_NAM.tif")

# ---- Paleta ----
verde  <- "#81C784"; blanco <- "white"
azul   <- "#002F70"; morado <- "#C10781"; rojo <- "#F79CD4"
fondo  <- "#F7F6F1"
grid   <- rgb(0.30, 0.30, 0.30, 0.25)
pal_alturas <- rep(verde, 100); pal_alturas[1] <- blanco
coltab(r) <- data.frame(
  value = c(0:99, 101, 102, 103),
  col   = c(pal_alturas, azul, morado, rojo)
)

# ---- Geometría del mapa ----
e      <- ext(r); w <- e[2] - e[1]; h <- e[4] - e[3]
midlat <- (e[3] + e[4]) / 2
asp    <- 1 / cos(midlat * pi / 180)
ratio  <- (h * asp) / w

# ---- Ventana proporcional al mapa + espacio para título ----
dev.new(width = 8.5, height = 8.5 * ratio * (8/9) + 1.2,
        unit = "in", noRStudioGD = TRUE)

par(family = "serif", fg = "grey30", col.axis = "grey40",
    cex.axis = 0.65, mar = c(3, 3.5, 3.8, 1.5))

# 1) Base: fija coordenadas y proporción
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(e[1], e[2]), ylim = c(e[3], e[4]),
            asp = asp, xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

# 2) Fondo del panel — solo el área del tiff
rect(e[1], e[3], e[2], e[4], col = fondo, border = NA)

# 3) Raster
plot(r, legend = FALSE, add = TRUE)

# 4) Retícula encima del raster, recortada al área del tiff
xg <- pretty(c(e[1], e[2]), 6); xg <- xg[xg > e[1] & xg < e[2]]
yg <- pretty(c(e[3], e[4]), 6); yg <- yg[yg > e[3] & yg < e[4]]
segments(xg, e[3], xg, e[4], col = grid, lwd = 0.5)
segments(e[1], yg, e[2], yg, col = grid, lwd = 0.5)

# 5) Ejes finos y marco ajustado exactamente al tiff
axis(1, at = xg, col = "grey75", col.ticks = "grey60", tck = -0.012)
axis(2, at = yg, col = "grey75", col.ticks = "grey60", tck = -0.012, las = 1)
rect(e[1], e[3], e[2], e[4], col = NA, border = "grey70", lwd = 0.8)


# 7) Escala y norte
sbar(1000, xy = c(e[1] + 0.05 * w, e[3] + 0.06 * h),
     type = "bar", divs = 4, below = "km", cex = 0.6, lonlat = TRUE)
north(xy = c(e[2] - 0.07 * w, e[3] + 0.10 * h), type = 2, cex = 0.8)

# 8) Leyenda — fondo transparente, título centrado, borde superior en latitud 50
legend(x = e[1] + 0.02 * w, y = 50,
       title  = "Clase",
       legend = c("Sin vegetación", "Vegetación", "101-> Agua", "102 ->hielo", "103 ->NAN"),
       fill   = c(blanco, verde, azul, morado, rojo),
       border = "grey55",
       bg = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.4),   # blanco semitransparente (baja a 0.2 o sube a 0.6 a gusto)
       box.col = "grey70",
       cex = 0.72, y.intersp = 1.25,
       text.col = "grey25",
       title.col = "grey15", title.font = 2,
       title.adj = 0.5,
       xpd = TRUE)

```

```{r}


# ---- Muestra en vez de cargar todo ----
set.seed(1)
vals <- spatSample(r, size = 2e6, method = "regular",
                   na.rm = TRUE, values = TRUE)[, 1]

# Conteo por valor (0–103) sobre la muestra ----
h <- hist(vals, breaks = 0:104 - 0.5, plot = FALSE)   # un bin por valor entero
val <- round(h$mids)
cnt <- h$counts
keep <- cnt > 0
val <- val[keep]; cnt <- cnt[keep]

# Colores por clase (mismos del mapa)
verde <- "#81C784"; azul <- "#002F70"; morado <- "#C10781"; rosa <- "#F79CD4"
fondo <- "#F7F6F1"; grid <- rgb(0.30, 0.30, 0.30, 0.25)

cols <- rep(verde, length(val))
cols[val == 0]   <- "grey70"
cols[val == 101] <- azul
cols[val == 102] <- morado
cols[val == 103] <- rosa

#  Ventana 
dev.new(width = 9, height = 5, unit = "in", noRStudioGD = TRUE)
par(family = "serif", fg = "grey30", col.axis = "grey45",
    col.lab = "grey30", cex.axis = 0.7, cex.lab = 0.9,
    mar = c(4, 4.8, 2.5, 1.2))

# ---- Escala log en Y ----
ylim <- c(0.7, max(cnt) * 1.3)
bp <- barplot(cnt, log = "y", ylim = ylim, names.arg = val,
              col = cols, border = "grey45", space = 0.2,
              axes = FALSE, las = 2, cex.names = 0.5)

# fondo + retícula
u <- par("usr")
rect(u[1], 10^u[3], u[2], 10^u[4], col = fondo, border = NA)
yticks <- 10^(0:ceiling(log10(max(cnt))))
abline(h = yticks, col = grid, lwd = 0.5)
barplot(cnt, log = "y", ylim = ylim, col = cols, border = "grey45",
        space = 0.2, axes = FALSE, add = TRUE)

# eje Y
axis(2, at = yticks, labels = format(yticks, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
     col = "grey80", col.ticks = "grey65", tck = -0.015, mgp = c(2, 0.5, 0), las = 1)
box(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.8)

# etiquetas y leyenda
mtext("Valor del píxel (altura en m · códigos 101–103)", side = 1, line = 2.6,
      cex = 0.9, col = "grey30")
mtext("Número de píxeles (escala log)", side = 2, line = 3.6,
      cex = 0.9, col = "grey30")

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Sin vegetación (0)", "Vegetación (1–99)",
                  "101 · Agua", "102 · Hielo", "103 · NA"),
       fill = c("grey70", verde, azul, morado, rosa),
       border = "grey55", bg = rgb(1,1,1,0.6), box.col = "grey70",
       cex = 0.7, y.intersp = 1.15)
```
```{r}
library(sf)
library(terra)

# ---- Recorte de Quintana Roo ----
mexico <- st_read("C:/Users/katy/Documents/KATY_TESIS_CL/insumos/QuintanaRoo_Entidad_MOD.gpkg",
                  quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_union() |> st_transform(crs = 32616)
hei.rast <- rast("C:/Users/katy/Documents/KATY_TESIS_CL/productos/Forest_height_QROO.tif")
lim <- project(vect(mexico), crs(hei.rast))
r   <- crop(hei.rast, ext(lim))

# ---- Paleta / simbología ----
verde  <- "#81C784"; blanco <- "white"
azul   <- "#002F70"; morado <- "#C10781"; rojo <- "#F79CD4"
fondo  <- "#F7F6F1"
grid   <- rgb(0.30, 0.30, 0.30, 0.25)
pal_alturas <- rep(verde, 100); pal_alturas[1] <- blanco
coltab(r) <- data.frame(
  value = c(0:99, 101, 102, 103),
  col   = c(pal_alturas, azul, morado, rojo)
)

# ---- Geometría ----
e   <- ext(r); w <- e[2] - e[1]; h <- e[4] - e[3]
lonlat <- is.lonlat(r)
asp    <- if (lonlat) 1 / cos(((e[3]+e[4])/2) * pi/180) else 1
ratio  <- (h * asp) / w

# ---- Ventana ----
dev.new(width = 8, height = 8 * ratio + 0.4, unit = "in", noRStudioGD = TRUE)
par(family = "serif", fg = "grey30", col.axis = "grey45",
    cex.axis = 0.6, mar = c(1.4, 1.4, 0.6, 1))

# 1) Base
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(e[1], e[2]), ylim = c(e[3], e[4]),
            asp = asp, xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

# 2) Fondo
rect(e[1], e[3], e[2], e[4], col = fondo, border = NA)

# 3) Raster
plot(r, legend = FALSE, add = TRUE)

# 4) Retícula
xg <- pretty(c(e[1], e[2]), 4); xg <- xg[xg > e[1] & xg < e[2]]
yg <- pretty(c(e[3], e[4]), 4); yg <- yg[yg > e[3] & yg < e[4]]
segments(xg, e[3], xg, e[4], col = grid, lwd = 0.4)
segments(e[1], yg, e[2], yg, col = grid, lwd = 0.4)

# 5) Ejes — X pegado; Y con etiquetas adentro, corridas un poco a la izquierda
axis(1, at = xg, labels = format(round(xg), big.mark = ""),
     col = "grey80", col.ticks = "grey65", tck = -0.010, mgp = c(2, 0, 0))

axis(2, at = yg, labels = FALSE, lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = 1,
     col.ticks = "grey65", tck = -0.010)
text(x = e[1], y = yg, labels = format(round(yg), big.mark = ""),
     pos = 2, offset = 0.1, cex = 0.6, col = "grey45", xpd = TRUE)   # pos = 2 = a la izquierda

rect(e[1], e[3], e[2], e[4], col = NA, border = "grey70", lwd = 0.8)

# 6) Escala y norte
dist <- if (lonlat) 50 else 50000
sbar(dist, xy = c(e[1] + 0.05 * w, e[3] + 0.05 * h),
     type = "bar", divs = 4, below = "km", cex = 0.55, lonlat = lonlat)
north(xy = c(e[2] - 0.08 * w, e[3] + 0.11 * h), type = 2, cex = 0.7)

# 7) Leyenda compacta
legend(x = e[1] + 0.03 * w, y = e[4] - 0.03 * h,
       title  = "Clase",
       legend = c("Sin vegetación", "Vegetación", "Agua", "Hielo", "NA"),
       fill   = c(blanco, verde, azul, morado, rojo),
       border = "grey60",
       bg = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.45), box.col = "grey75",
       cex = 0.6, y.intersp = 1.0, pt.cex = 0.9,
       text.col = "grey25",
       title.col = "grey15", title.font = 2,
       title.adj = 0.5, xpd = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Recortar y enmascarar al área de Quintana Roo

hei_clip <- mask(crop(hei.rast, lim), lim)

hei_clean <- ifel(hei_clip <= 0 | hei_clip >= 101, NA, hei_clip)
summary(hei_clean)
```
```{r}
# MAPA DE ALTURA (DATOS EN CRUDO)


ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = hei_clip) +
  geom_sf(data = mexico, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Valor de pixel",
    option = "viridis",
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Altura de Vegetación GLAD (Máscara)",
    subtitle = "Quintana Roo, México",
    x = "Longitud",
    y = "Latitud"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

```{r}
# Histograma de datos limpios (hei_clean) 
library(viridisLite)

alturas <- values(hei_clean, mat = FALSE)
alturas <- alturas[!is.na(alturas)]

fondo <- "white"; grid <- "gray90"   # fondo blanco + retícula tenue, como theme_minimal

dev.new(width = 7, height = 5, unit = "in", noRStudioGD = TRUE)
par(family = "serif", fg = "grey30", col.axis = "grey45",
    col.lab = "grey30", cex.axis = 0.75, cex.lab = 0.9,
    mar = c(4, 4.8, 2.5, 1.2))

h <- hist(alturas, breaks = 40, plot = FALSE)

# color viridis según la altura del centro de cada barra
rng     <- range(alturas)
pos     <- (h$mids - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
col_bar <- viridis(100)[pmax(1, ceiling(pos * 100))]

plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = range(h$breaks), ylim = c(0, max(h$counts) * 1.04),
            xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

# fondo + retícula horizontal
u <- par("usr"); rect(u[1], u[3], u[2], u[4], col = fondo, border = NA)
yg <- pretty(c(0, max(h$counts)), 6)
abline(h = yg, col = grid, lwd = 0.6)

# barras coloreadas con viridis
rect(h$breaks[-length(h$breaks)], 0, h$breaks[-1], h$counts,
     col = col_bar, border = "grey40", lwd = 0.4)

# media (etiqueta a la IZQUIERDA de la línea)
m <- mean(alturas)
abline(v = m, col = "#CF4436", lwd = 1.5, lty = 2)
text(m, max(h$counts) * 0.95,
     sprintf("media = %.1f m", m),
     col = "#CF4436", pos = 2, cex = 0.75)      # pos = 2 = a la izquierda

# ejes
axis(1, col = "grey80", col.ticks = "grey65", tck = -0.015, mgp = c(2, 0.4, 0))
axis(2, at = yg, labels = format(yg, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
     col = "grey80", col.ticks = "grey65", tck = -0.015, mgp = c(2, 0.5, 0), las = 1)
box(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.8)

# etiquetas
mtext("Altura del dosel (m)", side = 1, line = 2.4, cex = 0.9, col = "grey30")
mtext("Número de píxeles",     side = 2, line = 3.6, cex = 0.9, col = "grey30")
```
```{r}
library(terra)

# MÉTRICAS DE LIMPIEZA - ALTURA GLAD


# Raster completo ANTES del mask 
hei_original_temp      <- rast("../productos/Forest_height_QROO.tif")
hei_original_proj_temp <- project(hei_original_temp, crs(lim))   
val_completo <- values(hei_original_proj_temp, mat = FALSE)      

# Valores DENTRO del continente (después del mask)
val_crudo  <- values(hei_clip,  na.rm = TRUE)   
val_limpio <- values(hei_clean, na.rm = TRUE) 

# Conteos base 
n_total      <- ncell(hei_original_proj_temp)
n_na_crudo   <- sum(is.na(values(hei_clip, mat = FALSE)))   
n_validos_crudo  <- length(val_crudo)
n_validos_limpio <- length(val_limpio)
#  Agua 
agua_101_continente <- sum(val_crudo == 101, na.rm = TRUE)   
agua_oceano         <- n_na_crudo                           
agua_total          <- agua_oceano + agua_101_continente

#Píxeles <= 0 (océano vs continente) -
ceros_total      <- sum(val_completo <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
ceros_continente <- sum(val_crudo    <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
ceros_oceano     <- ceros_total - ceros_continente

# Eliminados por limpieza 
eliminados       <- n_validos_crudo - n_validos_limpio
pct_eliminado    <- eliminados / n_validos_crudo * 100
pct_ceros_oceano     <- ceros_oceano     / ceros_total * 100
pct_ceros_continente <- ceros_continente / ceros_total * 100

###################################################################
# REPORTE

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("MÉTRICAS DE LIMPIEZA - ALTURA GLAD\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")
cat("Total de píxeles en el raster:", format(n_total, big.mark = ","), "\n")

cat("\nDATOS EN CRUDO (hei_clip):\n")
cat("  - Píxeles NA (océano/fuera de máscara):", format(n_na_crudo, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  - Píxeles agua interior (101):         ", format(agua_101_continente, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  - Total píxeles de agua (NA + 101):    ", format(agua_total, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  - Píxeles con valores:                 ", format(n_validos_crudo, big.mark = ","), "\n")

cat("\nDATOS LIMPIOS (hei_clean):\n")
cat("  - Píxeles válidos (1-100 m):", format(n_validos_limpio, big.mark = ","), "\n")

cat("\nRESULTADOS DE LIMPIEZA:\n")
cat("  - Píxeles eliminados (<=0 y 101):", format(eliminados, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  - Porcentaje eliminado:", round(pct_eliminado, 2), "%\n")
cat("  - Porcentaje retenido:", round(100 - pct_eliminado, 2), "%\n")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("ANÁLISIS DE PÍXELES <=0 (OCÉANO vs CONTINENTE)\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")
cat("Total píxeles <=0 en raster completo:", format(ceros_total, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  - En OCÉANO (fuera de máscara):", format(ceros_oceano, big.mark = ","),
    "(", round(pct_ceros_oceano, 2), "%)\n")
cat("  - En CONTINENTE (dentro de máscara):", format(ceros_continente, big.mark = ","),
    "(", round(pct_ceros_continente, 2), "%)\n")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("ESTADÍSTICAS DE VALORES\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("\n--- DATOS EN CRUDO (dentro del continente) ---\n")
print(summary(val_crudo))
cat("\n--- DATOS LIMPIOS (1-100 m) ---\n")
print(summary(val_limpio))
cat("\n========================================\n")
```
